biotools.summary: PepFuNN is an open-source Python toolkit developed by Novo Nordisk Research for studying peptide libraries and performing structure-activity relationship analyses. It offers modules for physicochemical property calculations, similarity analysis, clustering, library design, and mutation selection based on experimental data.
